$note: 官祿宮（2026-10-12）：官祿連動。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 官祿宮 p.530–560。殉職、牢獄、官非、血光、貪墨、意外一類斷語不用；天刑、天月、天巫、龍池鳳閣、三台八座等引擎冇嘅星不用；天機見 tianji-guanlu.json（試點）。

rules.text: 你的官祿宮和夫妻宮星曜都吉利：夫妻可以合作事業，或者各自發展都成功，夫妻關係也和美。
rules.en: Your Career and Partnership Palaces are both favourable: you and your partner can work together, or both succeed separately, and the relationship stays warm.

rules.text: 你的官祿宮吉利，夫妻宮卻不吉利：夫妻只宜各自發展事業。
rules.en: Your Career Palace is favourable but your Partnership Palace is not: you and your partner should each pursue your own careers.

source.quote: 则只宜夫妻各自发展事业

rules.text: 你的官祿宮和夫妻宮星曜都不吉利：夫妻在事業上互相幫不上忙，夫妻之間不宜合作。
rules.en: Your Career and Partnership Palaces are both unfavourable: you and your partner cannot help each other’s careers, so the two of you should not work together.

rules.text: 你的官祿宮和夫妻宮，一宮有地空、一宮有地劫：事業容易因遷就伴侶而受影響，例如為伴侶放棄較好的職位；彼此又未必遷就得到底，也會影響感情。
rules.en: Your Career and Partnership Palaces hold Di Kong and Di Jie between them: your career can suffer from accommodating your partner, such as giving up a better post; yet neither of you can accommodate forever, and the relationship feels it too.

source.quote: 例如因迁就配偶，自己牺牲一份较优厚的职位等
